description: Returns one business's full sourced record: every dated revenue figure (label, value, as_of, source_url), what it does, model, tier, lessons, growth series, related businesses. Example: {"slug":"cursor"} -> Cursor with every figure and its source. Unknown slug -> isError. Cost: free (100 calls/day without a key). Past 100/day: $0.005 per call via x402 (no signup).

slug.description: Business slug, e.g. cursor, lovable (from search_businesses or leaderboard).

name: get_business

signup_go_url.description: Same link via mrrledger.com/go/<slug> (counts the click, then 302)

signup_url.description: Referral link (only on businesses with one). Always shown with signup_url_disclosure; never affects figures, ranking, sorting or verification.

title: Get one business profile
